name: Brian Hyman
reason: Work is built around addiction recovery: he teaches full-time at a Malibu rehab centre, his book (Recovery with Yoga: Supportive Practices for Transcending Addiction) and his classes are sold on recovery, and most of his Insight Timer courses are recovery or sobriety titled, so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule; he has no paid offering with its own page on his one-page Wix site, no YouTube channel, and only a contact form. What would pass is a couple of general Insight Timer courses (e.g. Mindful Breathwork, The Art of Being) and a free Udemy course.
